source: Position2 Meta launch checks (a starter, written from Meta's own campaign settings and the platform's Meta audit: the team's own Meta checks are not written down yet). Edit this file to change them.
sections: 2. Ad Set: audience, placements and optimisation
5. On the spot: policy and claims

items.expected: Should follow the format - P2_<MetaLeads, MetaSales, MetaTraffic or MetaAwareness>_<Theme>_<Launch date>
items.otherThingsToCheck: One campaign per theme, named like the Google campaigns.
items.verify: Expected: Should follow the format - P2_<MetaLeads, MetaSales, MetaTraffic or MetaAwareness>_<Theme>_<Launch date>. One campaign per theme, named like the Google campaigns.

items.expected: From the campaign book
items.otherThingsToCheck: Leads, Sales, Traffic or Awareness: the objective decides which checks apply.
items.verify: Expected: From the campaign book. Leads, Sales, Traffic or Awareness: the objective decides which checks apply.
items.onTheSpot: There is no plan to compare with. Judge the objective on its own: it should match the type in the campaign's name (MetaLeads is Leads, MetaSales is Sales, MetaTraffic is Traffic, MetaAwareness is Awareness) and what the ads ask people to do. Flag a mismatch and say why.

items.expected: From the campaign book: none, unless the ads are about credit, jobs, housing, or social issues, elections or politics
items.otherThingsToCheck: Declaring a category limits age, gender and postcode targeting. Declare it when the ads are about one of these, and not otherwise.
items.verify: Expected: From the campaign book: none, unless the ads are about credit, jobs, housing, or social issues, elections or politics. Declaring a category limits age, gender and postcode targeting. Declare it when the ads are about one of these, and not otherwise.
items.onTheSpot: There is no plan to compare with. Judge from the ads and the landing page whether a special ad category applies (credit, employment, housing, social issues, elections or politics). Flag a campaign that should declare one and does not, or declares one for no reason.

items.expected: Auction
items.otherThingsToCheck: Reach and Frequency (reservation) is a different way of buying and needs its own plan.
items.verify: Expected: Auction. Reach and Frequency (reservation) is a different way of buying and needs its own plan.

items.expected: From the campaign book
items.otherThingsToCheck: Campaign budget (Advantage campaign budget) or a budget on each ad set, daily or lifetime, and the amount.
items.verify: Expected: From the campaign book. Campaign budget (Advantage campaign budget) or a budget on each ad set, daily or lifetime, and the amount.
items.onTheSpot: There is no plan to compare with. Judge on its own: a budget so small that an ad set cannot reach about 50 results in a week at the account's usual cost per result stays in the learning phase. Flag it, with the numbers read.

items.expected: From the campaign book
items.otherThingsToCheck: Highest volume, Cost per result goal (cost cap), ROAS goal or Bid cap. A cap that is too low stops delivery.
items.verify: Expected: From the campaign book. Highest volume, Cost per result goal (cost cap), ROAS goal or Bid cap. A cap that is too low stops delivery.
items.onTheSpot: There is no plan to compare with. Judge the bid strategy on its own: highest volume is the normal start while a campaign has no history; a cost or ROAS goal needs enough results to hold. Flag a bid or cost cap with no results history behind it.

items.expected: Start date should be the date it is taken live, no end date unless the campaign book names one
items.verify: Expected: Start date should be the date it is taken live, no end date unless the campaign book names one.

items.expected: At least 1 active ad set, and at least 3 ads in each (Position2's default for Meta, as the Asset Coverage agent uses)
items.otherThingsToCheck: No more than 10 ads in an ad set: Meta splits the budget and none gets enough.
items.verify: Expected: At least 1 active ad set, and at least 3 ads in each (Position2's default for Meta, as the Asset Coverage agent uses). No more than 10 ads in an ad set: Meta splits the budget and none gets enough.

items.expected: A Facebook Page and an Instagram account are set on every ad
items.otherThingsToCheck: An ad with no Instagram account is shown on Instagram under the Page's name.
items.verify: Expected: A Facebook Page and an Instagram account are set on every ad. An ad with no Instagram account is shown on Instagram under the Page's name.

items.section: 2. Ad Set: audience, placements and optimisation
items.expected: From the campaign book
items.otherThingsToCheck: Website, Instant forms, Calls, Messaging or App: where the result happens.
items.verify: Expected: From the campaign book. Website, Instant forms, Calls, Messaging or App: where the result happens.
items.onTheSpot: There is no plan to compare with. Judge on its own: the conversion location must match where the ads send people (a website address, an instant form, a phone number). Flag a mismatch.

items.section: 2. Ad Set: audience, placements and optimisation
items.expected: From the campaign book
items.otherThingsToCheck: For example Maximize number of leads or Maximize number of conversions. Link clicks on a campaign that is meant to bring leads is a mismatch.
items.verify: Expected: From the campaign book. For example Maximize number of leads or Maximize number of conversions. Link clicks on a campaign that is meant to bring leads is a mismatch.
items.onTheSpot: There is no plan to compare with. Judge on its own: the optimisation goal must match the objective (a Leads campaign should optimise for leads or conversions, a Sales campaign for purchases). Flag clicks or impressions on a campaign meant to bring leads or sales.

items.section: 2. Ad Set: audience, placements and optimisation
items.expected: A dataset is set, and the event is the one the campaign book names (for example Lead or Purchase)
items.verify: Expected: A dataset is set, and the event is the one the campaign book names (for example Lead or Purchase).

items.section: 2. Ad Set: audience, placements and optimisation
items.expected: From the campaign book (Meta's own default is a 7-day click and a 1-day view)
items.verify: Expected: From the campaign book (Meta's own default is a 7-day click and a 1-day view).
items.onTheSpot: There is no plan to compare with. Judge on its own: 7-day click and 1-day view is Meta's default and is normal. Flag a view-only window.

items.section: 2. Ad Set: audience, placements and optimisation
items.expected: From the campaign book
items.otherThingsToCheck: Every place the client serves is in, and nothing outside it. Check each country, state, city and radius.
items.verify: Expected: From the campaign book. Every place the client serves is in, and nothing outside it. Check each country, state, city and radius.
items.onTheSpot: There is no plan to compare with. Judge on its own: the places must be where the client serves customers (from the landing page and the account's other campaigns). Flag a country or region the client does not serve.

items.section: 2. Ad Set: audience, placements and optimisation
items.expected: People living in or recently in this location
items.verify: Expected: People living in or recently in this location.

items.section: 2. Ad Set: audience, placements and optimisation
items.expected: From the campaign book
items.otherThingsToCheck: Meta only lets a limit on age hold when Advantage+ audience is off.
items.verify: Expected: From the campaign book. Meta only lets a limit on age hold when Advantage+ audience is off.
items.onTheSpot: There is no plan to compare with. Judge on its own: the age range must fit the offer (and any legal minimum for it). Flag a range that excludes the people the offer is for.

items.section: 2. Ad Set: audience, placements and optimisation
items.expected: From the campaign book
items.verify: Expected: From the campaign book.
items.onTheSpot: There is no plan to compare with. Judge on its own: flag a gender that is left out when the offer is not gender specific.

items.section: 2. Ad Set: audience, placements and optimisation
items.expected: Left empty (all languages), unless the campaign book names one
items.verify: Expected: Left empty (all languages), unless the campaign book names one.

items.section: 2. Ad Set: audience, placements and optimisation
items.check: Audience: detailed targeting and Advantage+ audience
items.expected: From the campaign book
items.otherThingsToCheck: The interests, lookalikes and custom audiences named in the book, and whether Advantage+ audience is on (then they are only suggestions).
items.verify: Expected: From the campaign book. The interests, lookalikes and custom audiences named in the book, and whether Advantage+ audience is on (then they are only suggestions).
items.onTheSpot: There is no plan to compare with. Judge on its own: the audience must fit what the ads sell; flag an audience made only of very wide interests, and say whether Advantage+ audience is on.

items.section: 2. Ad Set: audience, placements and optimisation
items.expected: From the campaign book: existing customers and current leads excluded where the client has a list
items.verify: Expected: From the campaign book: existing customers and current leads excluded where the client has a list.
items.onTheSpot: There is no plan to compare with. Judge on its own: flag a retargeting or prospecting ad set that does not exclude people who have already converted, when the account has a customer or lead audience.

items.section: 2. Ad Set: audience, placements and optimisation
items.expected: From the campaign book (Advantage+ placements unless the book names others)
items.otherThingsToCheck: A manual placement that the creative does not fit (a 1:1 image in Stories) shows badly.
items.verify: Expected: From the campaign book (Advantage+ placements unless the book names others). A manual placement that the creative does not fit (a 1:1 image in Stories) shows badly.
items.onTheSpot: There is no plan to compare with. Judge on its own: Advantage+ placements is the normal setting. Flag manual placements that leave out Facebook or Instagram feeds without a reason.

items.expected: From the campaign book
items.otherThingsToCheck: Image, video or carousel. A campaign with more than one format gives Meta more to learn from.
items.verify: Expected: From the campaign book. Image, video or carousel. A campaign with more than one format gives Meta more to learn from.
items.onTheSpot: There is no plan to compare with. Judge on its own: flag a campaign whose ads are all one format and have no video.

items.expected: At most 125 characters before Meta cuts it with See more
items.otherThingsToCheck: Spelling, grammar, brand spelled as the client writes it, and no claim the client has not confirmed.
items.verify: Expected: At most 125 characters before Meta cuts it with See more. Spelling, grammar, brand spelled as the client writes it, and no claim the client has not confirmed.

items.expected: At most 40 characters (about 27 show on a phone)
items.otherThingsToCheck: Spelling, grammar, brand spelled as the client writes it.
items.verify: Expected: At most 40 characters (about 27 show on a phone). Spelling, grammar, brand spelled as the client writes it.

items.expected: At most 30 characters, or empty
items.otherThingsToCheck: Meta often does not show it.
items.verify: Expected: At most 30 characters, or empty. Meta often does not show it.

items.expected: A button that matches the objective (Learn more, Get quote, Book now, Contact us, Call now, Sign up or Apply now)
items.verify: Expected: A button that matches the objective (Learn more, Get quote, Book now, Contact us, Call now, Sign up or Apply now).

items.expected: Should be working, on the client's own site, and match the ad
items.otherThingsToCheck: Open every URL: it must load without an error.
items.verify: Expected: Should be working, on the client's own site, and match the ad. Open every URL: it must load without an error.

items.expected: Tracking parameters are set on every ad (utm_source, utm_medium and utm_campaign at least)
items.otherThingsToCheck: For example utm_source=meta&utm_medium=paid_social&utm_campaign={{campaign.name}}&utm_content={{ad.name}}
items.verify: Expected: Tracking parameters are set on every ad (utm_source, utm_medium and utm_campaign at least). For example utm_source=meta&utm_medium=paid_social&utm_campaign={{campaign.name}}&utm_content={{ad.name}}

items.expected: From the campaign book
items.otherThingsToCheck: Enhancements can change the client's approved text, image or music.
items.verify: Expected: From the campaign book. Enhancements can change the client's approved text, image or music.
items.onTheSpot: There is no plan to compare with. Judge on its own: flag enhancements that change the client's approved words or images when nothing says the client agreed.

items.expected: Every ad is Active: none disapproved or with issues
items.verify: Expected: Every ad is Active: none disapproved or with issues.

items.expected: The dataset the ad sets use has received the event in the last 7 days
items.otherThingsToCheck: Meta does not show this to the API: check it in Events Manager.
items.verify: Expected: The dataset the ad sets use has received the event in the last 7 days. Meta does not show this to the API: check it in Events Manager.

items.expected: Set up for the event the campaign optimises for
items.otherThingsToCheck: Server events make results survive blocked cookies. Check Events Manager.
items.verify: Expected: Set up for the event the campaign optimises for. Server events make results survive blocked cookies. Check Events Manager.

items.expected: Rated Good or better for the event the campaign optimises for
items.otherThingsToCheck: Check Events Manager.
items.verify: Expected: Rated Good or better for the event the campaign optimises for. Check Events Manager.

items.expected: The domain is verified and the event is in the aggregated event measurement list
items.otherThingsToCheck: Check Business Settings and Events Manager.
items.verify: Expected: The domain is verified and the event is in the aggregated event measurement list. Check Business Settings and Events Manager.

items.section: 5. On the spot: policy and claims
items.expected: No ad text or image says or suggests that the person seeing it has a health condition, a race, a religion, a sexuality, money trouble or another personal attribute
items.otherThingsToCheck: Write about the product and the need, not about the person.
items.verify: Expected: No ad text or image says or suggests that the person seeing it has a health condition, a race, a religion, a sexuality, money trouble or another personal attribute. Write about the product and the need, not about the person.

items.section: 5. On the spot: policy and claims
items.expected: Nothing in the ads that the client has not confirmed: a price, a percentage, free, a guarantee, best, a cure
items.verify: Expected: Nothing in the ads that the client has not confirmed: a price, a percentage, free, a guarantee, best, a cure.

items.section: 5. On the spot: policy and claims
items.expected: The ads follow the advertising rules of the client's industry (healthcare, finance, legal, regulated devices)
items.otherThingsToCheck: Use the compliance notes in the Business Research and the Campaign Book.
items.verify: Expected: The ads follow the advertising rules of the client's industry (healthcare, finance, legal, regulated devices). Use the compliance notes in the Business Research and the Campaign Book.
